subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should the restart-drain bypass remain entirely core-internal, or should OpenClaw intentionally expose a plugin SDK API that can enqueue during gateway draining?
rationale: The PR currently solves a real message-loss path by adding bypass plumbing, but that plumbing is visible through a public SDK queue type and changes the security/compatibility contract for plugins.

options.title: Keep Bypass Internal
options.body: Move the drain-only enqueue path behind core-owned restart plumbing, preserve the public plugin queue contract, and re-review after exact-head proof.

options.title: Promote Public SDK Bypass
options.body: Accept `enqueueInternal` as a supported plugin API only with maintainer-approved docs, compatibility tests, and security-boundary rationale.

options.title: Pause For Narrower Recovery Work
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers prefer the broader restart message recovery work tracked by the canonical issue and queue-persistence PRs.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Internal
recommendation.body: Move the drain-only enqueue path behind core-owned restart plumbing, preserve the public plugin queue contract, and re-review after exact-head proof.
